topic: Making a First Intake Call to a Counseling Center

script.title: A FIRST THERAPY CALL
script.scene_zh: 諮商中心 · 電話預約
script.story_hook: One phone call, and the hard part is done.
script.intro_zh: 一通電話打完，最難的部分就已經結束了。
script.welcome_en: Hi, welcome to today's intake call. Listen for booking and insurance phrases.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎來到今天的諮商預約電話。留意預約與保險的實用說法。
script.outro: And that's a first appointment booked. Listen once more and repeat along.
script.outro_zh: 第一次的預約就這樣談定了。再聽一遍，跟著一起說。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.title_quote: You already did the hard part
script.char_a_description: a quiet young man in his late twenties with short black hair shaved close on the sides, light stubble, a navy zip hoodie over a plain white tee, a small backpack on one shoulder, and a lean build
script.char_b_description: a warm middle-aged woman with shoulder-length dark hair streaked with silver, round wire glasses, a soft lavender cardigan over a cream blouse, small gold hoop earrings, and a calm seated posture

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, um, is this the counseling center?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ʌm ɪz ðɪs ðə ˈkaʊnsəlɪŋ ˈsɛntɚ/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，請問這裡是諮商中心嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is! You've reached Northside Community Counseling.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz jʊv ɹitʃt ˈnɔɹθsaɪd kəˈmjuːnəti ˈkaʊnsəlɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 是的，你接通的是北區社區諮商中心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great. My name's Eli, Eli Grant.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt maɪ ˈneɪmz ˈi laɪ ˈi laɪ ɡɹænt/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我叫 Eli，Eli Grant。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice to meet you, Eli. How can I help?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs tə mi tʃu ˈi laɪ haʊ kən aɪ hɛlp/
dialogue.zh: 很高興認識你，Eli。今天想聊些什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, I want to start therapy, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm aɪ wɑnt tə stɑɹt ˈθɛɹəpi aɪ θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我想開始接受諮商。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'm really glad you called us today.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm ˈɹiəli ɡlæd ju kɔld ʌs təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 你今天願意打這通電話，我們真的很開心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same, honestly. What's the first step like?
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm ˈɑnəstli wʌts ðə fɝst stɛp laɪk/
dialogue.zh: 我也一樣，老實說。第一步大概是什麼樣子？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We book an intake session, fifty minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi bʊk æn ˈinteɪk ˈsɛʃən ˈfɪfti ˈmɪnəts/
dialogue.zh: 我們會先安排一節初始會談，五十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, how soon is your next opening?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊkeɪ haʊ sun ɪz jɔɹ ˈnɛkst ˈoʊpənɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 好，你們最近的空檔是什麼時候？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm, let me check… Thursday the sixth.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm lɛt mi tʃɛk ˈθɝzdeɪ ðə sɪksθ/
dialogue.zh: 我查一下行事曆……週四，六號那天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thursday works! Um, do you have evening slots?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɝzdeɪ wɝks ʌm du ju hæv ˈivnɪŋ slɑts/
dialogue.zh: 週四沒問題！嗯，你們有晚間時段嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thursdays run late, until seven thirty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɝzdeɪz ɹʌn leɪt ʌnˈtɪl ˈsɛvən ˈθɝti/
dialogue.zh: 週四會開到比較晚，一直到七點半。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, I get off work at five.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt aɪ ɡɛt ˈɔf wɝk æt faɪv/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我五點下班。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six o'clock is safest. Shall I hold it?
dialogue.phonetic: /sɑks əˈklɑk ɪz ˈseɪfəst ʃæl aɪ hoʊld ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 六點最保險。要我先幫你留住這個時段嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes please, six works great for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs pliz sɑks wɝks ɡɹeɪt fɚ mi/
dialogue.zh: 好的謝謝，六點對我剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done. You're all set, Thursday at six.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn jʊɹ ɔl sɛt ˈθɝzdeɪ æt sɑks/
dialogue.zh: 搞定，都排好了，週四六點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: If plans change, is that a problem?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪf plænz tʃeɪndʒ ɪz ðæt ə ˈplɑbləm/
dialogue.zh: 要是行程有變動，會不會有問題？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just call a day ahead, no fee at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst kɔl ə deɪ əˈhɛd noʊ fi æt ˈɔl/
dialogue.zh: 只要提前一天打電話就好，完全不用罰金。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's fair. Can I ask about insurance now?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts fɛɹ kən aɪ æsk əˈbaʊt ɪnˈʃɜɚns naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 合理。那我可以先問保險的事嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, which plan do you have?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv ˈkɔɹs wɪtʃ plæn du ju hæv/
dialogue.zh: 當然，你的是哪家保險？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Blue Shield. Um, are you in-network with them?
dialogue.phonetic: /blu ʃild ʌm ɑɹ ju ɪn ˈnɛtwɝk wɪð ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 藍盾。嗯，你們在他們的給付網路裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We are, so your visits do count.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ɑɹ soʊ jɔɹ ˈvɪzəts du kaʊnt/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，所以你的每次會談都能適用保險。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What a relief, honestly. Is there a copay?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ə ɹɪˈlif ˈɑnəstli ɪz ðɛr ə ˈkoʊpeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 真是鬆了口氣。每次要另外自付嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Usually twenty to forty, it depends on your plan.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈjuʒəli ˈtɛnti tə ˈfɔɹti ɪt dɪˈpɛndz jɔɹ plæn/
dialogue.zh: 通常是二十到四十塊，看你的方案。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay. This is awkward, but it's for a friend.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊkeɪ ðɪs ɪz ˈɔkwɚd bʌt ɪts fɚ ə frɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 好。這個問題有點尷尬，但我是幫朋友問的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go ahead, no question is awkward here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊ əˈhɛd noʊ ˈkwɛstʃən ɪz ˈɔkwɚd hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 問吧，在這裡沒有什麼尷尬的問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if someone has no insurance at all?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf ˈsʌmwʌn hæz noʊ ˈɪnˌʃɜɚns æt ˈɔl/
dialogue.zh: 如果有人完全沒有保險呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great question, we offer a sliding scale.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt ˈkwɛstʃən wi ˈɑfɚ ə ˈslaɪdɪŋ skeɪl/
dialogue.zh: 問得好，我們有依收入浮動的收費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A sliding scale… what does that mean?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈslaɪdɪŋ skeɪl wʌt dʌz ðæt min/
dialogue.zh: 依收入浮動……那是什麼意思？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The fee goes down if income is lower.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə fi ɡoʊz daʊn ɪf ˈɪnˌkʌm ɪz ˈloʊɚ/
dialogue.zh: 收入比較低，要付的費用就比較低。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, that's actually smart. How low can it go?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðæts ˈæktʃuəli smɑɹt haʊ loʊ kən ɪt ɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 噢，這設計真聰明。最低可以降到多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Some sessions run just twenty dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /sʌm ˈsɛʃənz ɹʌn dʒʌst ˈtɛnti ˈdɑlərz/
dialogue.zh: 有些會談一節只要二十塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Huh. Do I prove the income somehow?
dialogue.phonetic: /hə du aɪ pɹuv ði ˈɪnˌkʌm ˈsʌmˌhaʊ/
dialogue.zh: 喔。那收入要有證明嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A recent pay stub works, no tax forms.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈɹisənt peɪ stʌb wɝks noʊ tæks fɔɹmz/
dialogue.zh: 最近的薪資明細就可以了，不用稅單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Noted. So what exactly do I bring Thursday?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊtɪd soʊ wʌt ɪɡˈzæktli du aɪ brɪŋ ˈθɝzdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 記下了。那週四我到底要帶什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Photo ID, your insurance card, and the stub.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfoʊtoʊ ˌaɪˈdi jɔɹ ɪnˈʃɜɚns kɑɹd ænd ðə stʌb/
dialogue.zh: 附照片的證件、保險卡，還有那份明細。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Anything else? Do I fill out paperwork first?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛniθɪŋ ɛls du aɪ fɪl aʊt ˈpeɪɚˌwɑrk fɝst/
dialogue.zh: 還有嗎？要先填一堆文件嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll email the forms, they take ten minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl ˈimeɪl ðə fɔɹmz ðeɪ teɪk tɛn ˈmɪnəts/
dialogue.zh: 我會把表格用電子郵件傳過去，填起來只要十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Email… um, can we fix my address first?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈimeɪl ʌm kən wi fɪks maɪ əˈdɹɛs fɝst/
dialogue.zh: 郵件……嗯，可以先改我的信箱嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, what's the best email for you?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ wʌts ðə bɛst ˈimeɪl fɚ ju/
dialogue.zh: 好啊，哪個信箱收信最適合？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's eli.grant at gmail… did you get that?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈi laɪ ɡɹænt æt ˈdʒimeɪl dɪd ju ɡɛt ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 是 eli.grant 加 gmail……都記下來了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm, it saved wrong, the letters look odd.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm ɪt seɪvd ɹɔŋ ðə ˈlɛɾɚz lʊk ɑd/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，存起來不對，字母看起來怪怪的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, I always confuse people spelling that.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ aɪ ɔlˌweɪz kənˈfjuz ˈpipəl ˈspɛlɪŋ ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 哈，我拼這個名字常常把人搞混。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I once spelled my own name wrong, true story.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wʌns spɛld maɪ oʊn neɪm ɹɔŋ tru ˈstɔɹi/
dialogue.zh: 我曾經把自己的名字也拼錯過，說真的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, that makes me feel better already.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ðæt meɪks mi fil ˈbɛɾɚ ˈælɹɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 這樣說起來，我已經安心不少了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Back to it, one more try, go ahead.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæk tə ɪt wʌn mɔɹ traɪ ɡoʊ əˈhɛd/
dialogue.zh: 我們回到郵件，再試一次，你唸給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: eli.grant… there, it landed this time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈi laɪ ɡɹænt ðɛɹ ɪt ˈlændɪd ðɪs taɪm/
dialogue.zh: eli.grant……好了，這次寄到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sent, with the forms and a map link.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛnt wɪð ðə fɔɹmz ænd ə mæp lɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 發出去了，裡面有表格，還有地圖連結。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. Is it weird if I bring someone?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt ɪz ɪt wɪɹd ɪf aɪ brɪŋ ˈsʌmwʌn/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。如果我帶一個人陪同會奇怪嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not at all, they can wait in the lobby.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ət ˈɔl ðeɪ kən weɪt ɪn ðə ˈlɑbi/
dialogue.zh: 一點都不會，陪同的人可以在大廳等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good to know. Um, is it scary there?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd tə noʊ ʌm ɪz ɪt ˈskɛɹi ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 知道就好。嗯，那地方會不會讓人緊張？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everyone's nervous at first, I promise.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvɹiˌwʌnz ˈnɝvəz æt fɝst aɪ ˈpɑməs/
dialogue.zh: 每個人一開始都緊張，我保證。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That helps a lot, honestly. Can I ask one more?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt hɛps ə lɑt ˈɑnəstli kən aɪ æsk wʌn mɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 老實說這幫了我大忙。可以再問一個嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, what's on your mind?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ wʌts ɑn jɔɹ maɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 當然，你想問什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you text me a confirmation too?
dialogue.phonetic: /kən ju tɛkst mi ə ˌkɑnfɚˈmeɪʃən tu/
dialogue.zh: 也可以傳簡訊跟我確認嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll text the details, absolutely.
dialogue.phonetic: /wil tɛkst ðə dɪˈteɪlz ˈæbsəˌlutli/
dialogue.zh: 確認細節會另外用簡訊發過去，沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You've been so helpful, thank you.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊv bɪn soʊ ˈhɛlpfəl θæŋk ju/
dialogue.zh: 你真的太幫忙了，謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you for making the call, Eli.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju fɚ ˈmeɪkɪŋ ðə kɔl ˈi laɪ/
dialogue.zh: 該說謝謝的是你，願意打出這通電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yeah, um, I almost dialed nine times today.
dialogue.phonetic: /jæ ʌm aɪ ˈoʊlmoʊst daɪəld naɪn taɪmz təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 唉，我今天差點要撥九次才打通。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You already did the hard part today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ˈɔlɹɛdi dɪd ðə ˈhɑɹd pɑɹt təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 最難的那一步，你今天已經做完了。

script.youtube_title: 【第一次諮商電話📞】「最難的那一步你已經做完了」🎧約時段・問保險・滑動收費💳｜聽完就敢自己打｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜A First Counseling Call
script.youtube_title_en: "You Already Did the Hard Part" — Booking a First Counseling Session by Phone
script.youtube_description:
「最難的那一步你已經做完了」——想開始諮商，卻卡在打電話這一步？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就是一通打給社區諮商中心的預約電話。

你會聽到：開場怎麼說明來意、怎麼問最近的空檔與晚間時段；保險是否在給付網路裡、copay 大概多少怎麼問；沒有保險時 sliding scale 浮動收費怎麼談、要帶什麼證明；還有信箱填錯當場改好、第一次會談前該帶證件與表格的完整問答。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與短句，反覆出現美國人講電話的自然語感：um、honestly、okay、so。聽完你就會用：How can I help、How soon is your next opening、Can I ask about insurance、Just call a day ahead。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱與小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"You already did the hard part" — the scariest step of starting therapy is often just making the call. This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice built around one phone call to a community counseling center.

You will hear: explaining why you called, asking for the next opening and evening slots; checking insurance, in-network status and copay; a sliding-scale fee for people without insurance and what proof to bring; plus a small email mix-up fixed on the spot and everything to bring to the first visit.

Everything stays in A2-level words with the natural phone-speech rhythm Americans use: um, honestly, okay, so. By the end you'll own phrases like How soon is your next opening, Can I ask about insurance, and Just call a day ahead.

The second half is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.

script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
想約諮商，但最難的是先打通那通電話，對嗎？時段怎麼問、保險會不會理、沒有保險是不是就貴到沒辦法？第一次會談到底要帶些什麼？

這一集帶大家聽一通完整的預約電話：從說明來意、選晚間時段、確認保險在給付網路內，到依收入浮動的收費、薪資明細當證明，最後信箱出錯當場修正，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
📅 約時段：Okay, how soon is your next opening?
🛡️ 問保險：Blue Shield. Um, are you in-network with them?
💵 浮動收費：Great question, we offer a sliding scale.
📋 確認清單：Photo ID, your insurance card, and the stub.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、well、so 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。跟著這通電話走一遍，下次你真的要打時，話就自己從嘴邊冒出來。

祝你也順利打完那通電話。
